title: Bashar :: Explorations with Bashar - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: The excerpt features a direct question-and-answer exchange where someone expresses regret over declining a dream job due to indecision. Bashar addresses this by emphasizing that regret itself must be released and reframed as a learning opportunity. He instructs the questioner to apply a formula for manifestation that will attract similar fulfilling opportunities. Bashar clarifies that the replacement opportunity need not be identical but will provide equivalent soul-level satisfaction. The core teaching centers on releasing victim narratives and moving forward with positive expectation.

qa_topics.question: How can I manifest another opportunity after turning down my dream job?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Release regret and the belief you made a mistake. Apply the formula to attract similar opportunities that will be equally fulfilling, even if not identical in form.

quotes.quote: You have to give up regret. You have to give up the idea that you made a mistake.
By following the formula attract what you need in life and if it's not absolutely identical it will be similar enough.
Whatever form it takes it will feel as fulfilling as whatever that past expression might have been.
